mapper.sql: investment_id, plan_id, account_id, investment_no, bond_code, bond_type, issuer, purchase_price, purchase_quantity, purchase_date, current_price, current_value, face_value, coupon_rate, yield_to_maturity, maturity_date, maturity_value, next_coupon_date, accrued_interest, sell_price, sell_quantity, sell_date, realized_gain_loss, unrealized_gain_loss, investment_status, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, org_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE bond_code = #{bondCode} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE bond_type = #{bondType} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE issuer = #{issuer} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE investment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE investment_status = 'MATURED' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY maturity_date DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE investment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND maturity_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY maturity_date ASC

SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE investment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_coupon_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY next_coupon_date ASC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE bond_type = 'GOVERNMENT' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE bond_type = 'CORPORATE' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT bond_type as type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(current_value) as totalValue FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY bond_type
SELECT issuer, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(current_value) as totalValue FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY issuer ORDER BY totalValue DESC
SELECT investment_status as status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(current_value) as totalValue FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY investment_status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(realized_gain_loss), 0) FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND realized_gain_loss IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(coupon_rate), 0) FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND coupon_rate IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(yield_to_maturity), 0) FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND yield_to_maturity IS NOT NULL

SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND yield_to_maturity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY yield_to_maturity DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) as bondCount, SUM(current_value) as totalValue, AVG(coupon_rate) as avgCouponRate, AVG(yield_to_maturity) as avgYield, SUM(unrealized_gain_loss) as totalUnrealizedGainLoss FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY bond_type

SELECT YEAR(purchase_date) as year, MONTH(purchase_date) as month, COUNT(*) as bondCount, SUM(purchase_price * purchase_quantity) as totalInvestment, AVG(yield_to_maturity) as avgYield FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE YEAR(purchase_date) = #{year} AND org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY YEAR(purchase_date), MONTH(purchase_date) ORDER BY year, month
mapper.update:
UPDATE gt_bond_investment SET investment_status = #{investmentStatus}, update_user = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE investment_id IN
#{investmentId}

UPDATE gt_bond_investment SET current_price = #{currentPrice}, current_value = #{currentValue}, unrealized_gain_loss = #{currentValue} - (purchase_price * purchase_quantity), update_user = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE investment_id = #{investmentId}
UPDATE gt_bond_investment SET accrued_interest = #{accruedInterest}, update_user = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE investment_id = #{investmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE investment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND maturity_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY maturity_date ASC

SELECT FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE investment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_coupon_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY next_coupon_date ASC

SELECT bond_type, AVG(yield_to_maturity) as avgYield, COUNT(*) as bondCount, 'HIGH_YIELD_BOND_TYPE' as recommendationType, CONCAT('推荐债券类型：', bond_type, '，平均收益率：', ROUND(AVG(yield_to_maturity) * 100, 2), '%') as recommendationReason FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND yield_to_maturity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bond_type HAVING AVG(yield_to_maturity) > ( SELECT AVG(yield_to_maturity) * 1.1 FROM gt_bond_investment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ) ORDER BY avgYield DESC LIMIT 5
